curation.notes: Force-distance-curve AFM (JPK ForceRobot 300) with His6-tagged Tn4430 TnpA transposase (WT and the deregulated mutants TnpA3X and TnpAS911R) on NTA-PEG tips probing DNA carrying one or two transposon ends that is clicked onto gold surfaces. Dynamic force spectroscopy at retraction speeds of 0.1-10 µm/s gives koff and xu, and binding probability versus contact time gives kon/KD; a competition assay with free IR end-2 DNA is included. Cryo-EM and SAXS complement the study.
